description: This file defines a PHP class for rendering a Google Map interface for editing marker locations within the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Markers'. It includes methods for displaying the map, handling geocoding, and updating marker positions, integrating with SuiteCRM user preferences and configuration.

classes.name: Jjwg_MarkersViewMarker_Edit_Map
classes.description: A view class for rendering and managing the Google Map marker editing interface within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the HTML page with embedded JavaScript to initialize and manage the Google Map, handle geocoding, and update marker positions.
